scientific_scope_status: Homogeneous quartics on finite-dimensional real spaces with positivity in directions null for one indefinite quadratic form; planar rank-one directions are det=0. All35 planar coefficients are allowed for nullspace closure; the full9 left-SO2 invariant cone is used for exceptional-class and singular-face Jensen theorems. Exact singular faces,positive-definite sectors and near-singular limits are distinct.
